audience: developers who call LLMs and expert AI models through one Eden AI key

useCases.title: Choose an LLM by context and price
useCases.text: List the LLM chat models with context length, pricing, regions and capabilities, then pick one model id.

useCases.title: Find the input for an expert feature
useCases.text: List the expert features, such as OCR and text moderation. Read one subfeature to see its providers and input schema.

useCases.title: Extract text from a scanned document
useCases.text: Run an OCR expert model with the input its schema asks for, then read the result. Each call is billed to the account.

useCases.title: Check a comment with text moderation
useCases.text: Read the moderation schema, then run a text moderation model on one comment. The result shows whether the text is flagged. Each call is billed.

useCases.title: Ask an LLM to summarize a passage
useCases.text: Send a chat request to one LLM model and read the reply. Each call is billed to the account.
